Anthropic Claude subscription usage limits change June 2026 agents OpenClaw

sources_considered.why: S-1 gross margin figures give context on whether current products are sold at a loss.
Gives context that flat-rate heavy agent use was underpriced.

evidence_items.locator: entry 'Anthropic's implied gross margins have exploded', paragraph 1

receipt.public_excerpt: Anthropic reported its cost of revenue as $2.38 billion as of June 30, 2026, booking $16.29 billion in revenue during the same period and implying a gross margin of 85%.

evidence_items.explanation: Current products were sold well above their serving costs in the first half of 2026. That does not test his 'reliable version', which is not defined.

evidence_items.locator: section 'The economics that broke the model', paragraph 3

receipt.public_excerpt: industry analysts had noted a price gap of more than five times between what heavy agentic users paid under flat subscriptions and what equivalent usage would cost at API rates.

evidence_items.explanation: Shows heavy agent use under flat plans was underpriced. This fits his framing but does not test the 'reliable version' claim.

unresolved_gaps: No definition or measurement exists for a 'reliable version' of an LLM product or its costs.
